\section[(dialogue)]{Clothes and things you carry — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R127-first-pass-clothes-and-things-you-carry}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an idea and a problem.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item boots, a cap, a swimsuit; a sports shirt, size; the waist, a wallet
  \item a jewel, a ring, a necklace, perfume, a letter
  \item beef; an ox, vegetables, a mushroom, beans, a cucumber
  \item a strawberry, a cherry, a melon, garlic, flour
  \item beer, juice, ice cream; ice; a mirror, chocolate, a biscuit
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Boots? (\textbf{les bottes}.) A cap? (\textbf{la casquette}.) A swimsuit; a sports shirt? (\textbf{le maillot}.) Size; the waist? (\textbf{la taille}.) A wallet? (\textbf{le portefeuille}.) A jewel? (\textbf{le bijou}.) A ring? (\textbf{la bague}.) A necklace? (\textbf{le collier}.) Perfume? (\textbf{le parfum}.) A letter? (\textbf{la lettre}.) Beef; an ox? (\textbf{le bœuf}.) Vegetables? (\textbf{les légumes}.) A mushroom? (\textbf{le champignon}.) Beans? (\textbf{les haricots}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{le concombre}.) A strawberry? (\textbf{la fraise}.) A cherry? (\textbf{la cerise}.) A melon? (\textbf{le melon}.) Garlic? (\textbf{l'ail}.) Flour? (\textbf{la farine}.) Beer? (\textbf{la bière}.) Juice? (\textbf{le jus}.) Ice cream; ice; a mirror? (\textbf{la glace}.) Chocolate? (\textbf{le chocolat}.) A biscuit? (\textbf{le biscuit}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Food and work — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R127-second-pass-food-and-work}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a sandwich and a sauce.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a sandwich, a sauce, vinegar, a dessert, a meal
  \item a nurse, a cook, a police officer, a shop assistant, a farmer
  \item a baker, a student, a driver, a lawyer; an avocado, an engineer
  \item a firefighter, a postman, a waiter, a customer, a till
  \item a class; a classroom, a lesson, an exam, a word, a board; a painting
  \item a rubber, homework, an answer, an idea, a problem
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A sandwich? (\textbf{le sandwich}.) A sauce? (\textbf{la sauce}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{le vinaigre}.) A dessert? (\textbf{le dessert}.) A meal? (\textbf{le repas}.) A nurse? (\textbf{l'infirmière}.) A cook? (\textbf{le cuisinier}.) A police officer? (\textbf{le policier}.) A shop assistant? (\textbf{le vendeur}.) A farmer? (\textbf{l'agriculteur}.) A baker? (\textbf{le boulanger}.) A student? (\textbf{l'étudiant}.) A driver? (\textbf{le chauffeur}.) A lawyer; an avocado? (\textbf{l'avocat}.) An engineer? (\textbf{l'ingénieur}.) A firefighter? (\textbf{le pompier}.) A postman? (\textbf{le facteur}.) A waiter? (\textbf{le serveur}.) A customer? (\textbf{le client}.) A till? (\textbf{la caisse}.) A class; a classroom? (\textbf{la classe}.) A lesson? (\textbf{la leçon}.) An exam? (\textbf{l'examen}.) A word? (\textbf{le mot}.) A board; a painting? (\textbf{le tableau}.) A rubber? (\textbf{la gomme}.) Homework? (\textbf{les devoirs}.) An answer? (\textbf{la réponse}.) An idea? (\textbf{l'idée}.) A problem? (\textbf{le problème}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
